text: The Complete Blood Count results show a significant reduction in red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets, known as pancytopenia. Do you have any history of fever, night sweats, weight loss, or swollen lymph nodes? Also, have you been exposed to any new medications or chemicals recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myelodysplastic Syndrome (MDS). The combination of pancytopenia, splenomegaly, and specifically the presence of dysplastic megakaryocytes on the bone marrow biopsy confirms a myelodysplastic process, likely secondary to his chronic smoking history.
